detail.title: 4MP 25x Starlight IR 4G NETWORK PTZ CAMERA
detail.overview: Compare Favourite SD49425DB-HNY-GQ-LA 4MP 25x Starlight IR 4G NETWORK PTZ CAMERA Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 4MP Resolution • 25× Optical Zoom Provide Close Up Views Over Expansive Areas • Expansive Night View With up to 100 m IR Distance for 24/7 Monitoring • Supports 4G Signal Transmission and Can Be Used in Environments without Network • Supports Low Power Consumption Mode and Long-Term Monitoring • Deep Learning-Based Human and Vehicle Classification • Face Detection：Leveraging Facial Data to Enhance Analytics Accuracy • IP66 & TVS 6000V Protection with Lightning/Surge/Voltage Transient Resistance Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: Color: 0.005 lux@F1.6 B/W: 0.0005 lux@F1.6 0 lux (illuminator on)
General.Pan/Tilt Range: Pan: 0° to 360° endless Tilt: –15° to +90°, auto flip 180°
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Tripwire; intrusion; crossing fence detection; loitering detection; abandoned/missing object; fast moving; parking detection; people gathering; vehicle/human alarm classification
General.Face Detection: Supports face detection, capturing snapshots, and enhancing face images. Face cutout is also offered, where you can cutout one face at a time and customize the size to be a one-inch photo. The supported methods for capturing snapshots are real-time capturing and quality first
General.Auto Patrol: It triggers the IVS rule when a target is detected and makes the camera link with the PTZ to rotate to the position of the target and patrol based on its presets
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 4 MP/3 MP/1080p/1.3 MP/720p @(1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 1: D1/CIF/VGA@ (1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 2: 720p@(1–25/30 fps)
General.White Balance: Auto; indoor; outdoor; tracking; manual; sodium lamp; natural light; street lamp
General.Privacy Masking: Up to 24 areas can be set, with up to 8 areas in the same view; multiple colors available
General.Audio Compression: G.711a; G.711Mu; G.726; MPEG2-Layer2; G722.1; PCM
General.Wake-up Type: SMS:2G/3G; Streaming:4G(DMSS); Alarm:Local alarm input; Schedule
General.Wireless Carrier Frequency Band: LTE-TDD: Dual-band Band 38/40 LTE-FDD: Eleven-band Band 1/2/3/4/5/7/8/28/12/17/66 WCDMA: Hexa-band Band1/2/3/4/5/8 GSM:Quad-band Band 1/3/5/8
General.Max. Transmission Power: 4G: Power class3: 23dBm ±2dB 3G: Power class3: 24dBm +1/-3dB 2G: Power class0: 30dBm ±2dB (GSM1800/1900) Power class5: 33dBm ±2dB (GSM850/900)S
General.Storage: FTP; Micro SD card (512 GB); NAS
General.Browser: IE 9 and later versions Chrome 41 and later versions Firefox 50 and later versions Safari 10 and later versions
General.Certifications: CE: EN55032/EN55024/EN50130-4 FCC: Part15 subpartB, ANSI C63.4-2014
General.Alarm Linkage: Capture; recording; send email; preset; pattern; tour; alarm digital input
General.Alarm Event: Motion/tampering detection; audio detection; network disconnection detection; IP conflict detection; memory card state detection; memory space detection
General.Power Consumption: Deep sleep: 0.05 W light sleep: 2.5 W Basic: 3.75 W (not pulling stream in 4G); 4.54 (pulling stream in 4G); 7.98 W (illuminator+not pulling stream in 4G); 8.77 W (illuminator+pulling stream in 4G) Max: 15.49 W (illuminator+PTZ+pulling stream in 4G)
General.Protection: IP66, TVS 6000 V lightning proof; surge protection; voltage transient protection
